content:
Implemented and committed recursive agent delegation on branch `fix/recursive-agent-delegation` in commit `2260b23`.

The handler runs delegated instructions, feeds the result back to the delegating agent, and handles unknown agents, sub-agent failures, and circular delegation. Anthropic streamed tool calls are also translated into the handler’s delegation format.

**Verification:** TypeScript type-checking and the temporary delegation and simulated provider-stream reproductions passed. The full backend suite did not pass: it reported five failing tests, including abort-controller cleanup and screenshot-related tests, plus an OpenAI test file that could not be transformed because it uses `await` outside an async function. Temporary reproduction scripts were removed.
